name: Maou Quest
source:
-Gruen history 995, spring-

For 995 years, humans and monsters fought in a never-ending battle.

And today, as if to start another never-ending battle, young human people challenge the Demon King.

[Taken from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12606]Freem![/url]]
translation:
-格鲁恩历史995，春天-

995年来，人类与妖怪进行着永无休止的战斗。

而今天，人类年轻人仿佛又要开始一场永无休止的战斗，向魔王发起挑战。

[摘自 [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12606]Freem![/url]]
